UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile for an authenticated AUNARA studio user.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the studio navigation.

email.description: Verified email address of the user (PII, strictly owner/admin read-only).

photoUrl.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID containing user identity and PII.
